title: Agentic, Conversational, and Multi-hop Retrieval: Visual Guide
outline: Title: Agentic, Conversational, and Multi-hop Retrieval: Visual Guide

1. Query Becomes Material | the bridge: chunking and context assembly on one side, the query-side levers on the other, with eight symptoms routed to whichever side owns the fix and what it costs | everything already taught treats the query as a fixed input, and every technique in this lesson buys recall or robustness with the same currency - extra model calls and latency

2. Four Ways To Rewrite | a segmented control over rewriting, expansion, HyDE and conversational rewriting, showing the query before and after, a variants slider that multiplies retrieval cost, and a query-type toggle that flips HyDE from win to loss | all four are pre-retrieval transforms of the query itself, so rewriting comes first at 100-300 ms, expansion stays at two to four variants fused with RRF, and HyDE helps on conceptual queries and hurts on precise entity lookups

3. Search, Read, Stop | the agentic loop stepped one search at a time against a simple factual question or a multi-entity comparison, with a tool-call budget slider and live coverage, marginal-utility and budget signals | the hard part is not searching but stopping, so a decide-to-stop policy weighs coverage, marginal utility and a hard cap of three to five searches, and easy questions must be routed away from a loop that costs about ten seconds before generation starts

4. Hops Multiply | sliders for hop count and per-hop retrieval success, a cumulative survival bar per hop with the multiplication written out, and the three decomposition mechanisms | multi-hop success is the product of per-hop successes, so 0.9 over three hops is 0.73 before any reasoning error, and a wrong entity does not stop the chain - it poisons the next query

5. Gates And Guardrails | two modes: self-correcting RAG with three toggleable gates and a live cost multiplier, and text-to-SQL where turning off schema linking, exemplars, value grounding or guardrails degrades the generated query in a specific named way | each gate is another model call so a fully checked pipeline costs two to four times single-pass and must have a budget and a fall-through to abstention, and generated SQL is never executed raw
